teaser.en: A forked-thorn bush seen as the wild, outdoor twin of a spirit medicine bought in Indian shops.
teaser.sw: Kichaka chenye miiba yenye panda kinachochukuliwa kuwa pacha wa porini wa dawa ya pepo inayonunuliwa madukani mwa Wahindi.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chenye miya ya panda, chinachoonwa dza patsa wa weruni wa dawa ya pepho inayogulwa madukani ga Ahindi.

summary.en: Nvuje ya nze is a spiny num-num bush with white, starry flowers and red berries. The Digo regard it as the wild form of nvuje, a spirit-related medicine sold in shops.
summary.sw: Nvuje ya nze ni kichaka chenye miiba cha jamii ya *num-num*, chenye maua meupe kama nyota na matunda mekundu. Wadigo hukichukulia kuwa aina ya porini ya nvuje, dawa inayohusiana na pepo inayouzwa madukani.
summary.dg: Nvuje ya nze ni chitsaka cha *num-num* chenye miya, maruwa mereru ga umbo ra nyota na matunda madide ga kundu. Adigo anachiona dza aina ya weruni ya *nvuje*, dawa ya pepho inayoguzwa madukani.

about.en:
*Nvuje ya nze* is a dense, evergreen shrub with glossy, leathery, oval leaves in opposite pairs. Its stems carry sharp spines that are usually forked into two, and broken twigs bleed a white latex.

The white flowers are small, starry and sweetly scented, and are followed by oval berries that ripen bright red. The Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw:
*Nvuje ya nze* ni kichaka kizito kisichopukutisha majani, chenye majani yanayong'aa, magumu kama ngozi, ya umbo la yai, yaliyopangwa kwa jozi zinazoelekeana. Mashina yake yana miiba mikali ambayo kwa kawaida imegawanyika kuwa panda mbili, na vitawi vilivyovunjika hutoa utomvu mweupe.

Maua meupe ni madogo, kama nyota na yenye harufu nzuri, yakifuatwa na matunda ya beri ya umbo la yai yanayoiva na kuwa mekundu angavu. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg:
*Nvuje ya nze* ni chitsaka chenye panda nyinji zinazobanana, chenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ganang'ala, ni magumu dza chingo na ga mviringo, na ganamera mairi-mairi ganalolana. Mihiye ina miya mikali, ambayo kpwa kawaida inaganyika kukala ntsa mbiri, na maphungo gachivundzika ganalavya maziya mereru.

Maruwa mereru ni madide, ga umbo ra nyota na genye arufu nono, na badaye kunatuluka matunda ga mviringo ganayoivwa kukala ga kundu sana. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush, thicket and forest margins in eastern and southern Africa. Pakia recorded it among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya pwani, vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika. Pakia alikiripoti miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni pwani, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, Afrika ya Mlairo na ya Kusini. Pakia wachiandika kahi ya Adigo a pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: No Digo use is recorded. Elsewhere in Africa the ripe red berries of *Carissa bispinosa* are eaten.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi ya Kidigo yaliyoripotiwa. Kwingineko barani Afrika, matunda mekundu yaliyoiva ya *Carissa bispinosa* huliwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa. Phatu phanjina Afrika, matunda maivu ga kundu ga *Carissa bispinosa* nkuriwa.

culture.en: Pakia explains that *nvuje* is an Indian medicine, used against spirits, that is sold in shops. This plant is seen as the wild form of the same thing, the *nvuje* of outside.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba *nvuje* ni dawa ya Kihindi, inayotumika dhidi ya pepo, inayouzwa madukani. Mmea huu huchukuliwa kuwa aina ya porini ya kitu hichohicho, *nvuje* ya nje.
culture.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala *nvuje* ni dawa ya Ahindi, inayohumirwa kuzuwiya pepho, na inaguzwa madukani. Chitsaka chichi chinaonwa dza aina ya weruni ya dawa ihi ihi, *nvuje* ya kondze.

names.en: Pakia records *nvuje ya nze*, '*nvuje* of outside', the wild counterpart of the shop-bought *nvuje*. No Swahili name is recorded. In English it is called forest num-num or hedge thorn. Its relative *Carissa spinarum* is *mtambuu* in Digo.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *nvuje ya nze*, '*nvuje* ya nje', mwenzi wa porini wa *nvuje* inayonunuliwa dukani. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *forest num-num* au *hedge thorn*. Ndugu yake *Carissa spinarum* kwa Kidigo ni *mtambuu*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nvuje ya nze*, '*nvuje* ya kondze', aina ya weruni ya *nvuje* inayogulwa dukani. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *forest num-num* au *hedge thorn*. Nduguye *Carissa spinarum* kpwa Chidigo ni *mtambuu*.
